items.expect: A behavior-specific regression executes actual game logic and asserts steering, word contact, completion before drying, and continuous drying during elapsed active play.
items.missing: Add tests/test_blot_browser.py with a BlotBrowserTests class and an executable JavaScript/browser bridge. Because unittest discovery can succeed with no matching file, this command is not valid verification until that file and its assertions exist. Include assertions that contact marks words and that active elapsed time reaches drying failure.

items.statement: A person plays Blot in the browser through Taste v and judges whether it is readable and fun.
